blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.
blocks.zh: 非刚性登记,将一个图像扭曲成几何协议的像素视向变形场的恢复,是医学成像、结构生物学和函证估算的根本,但基于学习的方法面临一个严重的瓶颈:地面-真实变形场对真实数据来说是众所周知的难以获得的。 我们提出2D Gum-Net,一种端到端的架构,预测密度弹性变形场完全不受监督. 我们把最初在低温-电子成像图中为3D子tomogram对接而开发的几何无监督匹配网络(Gum-Net)转移到了2D弹性注册:所有三个模块都是在2D中重新设计的,而刚性变换头被一个Dense空间变换器所取代,这个变换器会倒退出一个稀有的控制点网格,通过双相插入被提升到全分辨率字段$-$-. 下采样使用DCT光谱集合,作为冷冻-基质矩阵乘法执行(约合50\times$ GPU加速),保留最大和平均集合破坏的细而半周期结构. 我们评价基于接触的指纹,这是这项工作的一个挑战性测试板:当地自相仿的山脊图案使通信变得极其模糊;皮肤被压在传感器上会产生真实的大迁移弹性扭曲;微微分是精确的地标,独立匹配者通过该地标对所预测的字段的地貌正确性进行外部验证。 我们的方法在FVC2004上提高了高达15.7%的结构相关性, 并在独立配对者下提高了真正的配对分, 这表明所预想的变形在不虚构通信的情况下恢复了真实的结构.

blocks.en: In this work we transfer an unsupervised registration paradigm across both domain and dimensionality. The Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net) of Zeng et al. [ 4 ] aligns 3D subtomograms in cryogenic electron tomography (cryo-ET) without any labels, reducing alignment error by 40–50% while accelerating the overall process 70–110 × \times . Its mechanism, dense symmetric correlation of deep feature maps followed by transformation regression, is largely modality-agnostic [ 2 , 4 ] . We hypothesize that the same mechanism, redesigned in two dimensions, solves general 2D elastic registration. Our adaptation ( Figure 1 ) differs from the original in two fundamental ways: all three modules are rebuilt for 2D inputs, and, more consequentially, the rigid transformation head is replaced with a Dense Spatial Transformer, which regresses a sparse control-point grid of 2 ​ G 2 2G^{2} local displacements lifted to a full-resolution dense field 𝚽 \mathbf{\Phi} by bicubic interpolation. This changes the transformation class from rigid motions to a smooth, expressive family of elastic warps, keeping the field smooth by construction and the parameter count small.

blocks.en: We evaluate this framework on contact-based fingerprint alignment, and we argue that fingerprints are a deliberately demanding testbed for dense elastic registration rather than merely an application. First, ridge patterns are quasi-periodic and locally self-similar: sliding a patch by one ridge wavelength produces a near-perfect local match that is globally wrong, so local matching faces an extreme aperture problem and a registration network succeeds only by integrating long-range spatial context. Second, the deformations are authentic and free: elastic skin pressed and twisted against a rigid sensor produces genuine large-displacement, non-linear warps in every acquisition [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] , on which rigid and affine models demonstrably fail. Third, the domain supplies an independent verification oracle . Registration evaluation is usually circular, since alignment quality is measured with the same class of similarity functional that was optimized. Fingerprint minutiae, by contrast, are precise point landmarks consumed by an external matching algorithm: a field that restores true structure raises genuine match scores while leaving imposter scores unchanged, whereas a field that hallucinates or folds structure is immediately penalized. Fourth, the correspondence signal is concentrated in a narrow fine-scale band (the ridge frequency), so fingerprints isolate the causal effect of information-preserving downsampling: pooling that destroys the ridge band destroys registration. Finally, procedural synthetic generators provide unlimited template–impression training pairs, leaving real benchmarks untouched for zero-shot transfer evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价这个基于接触的指纹校正框架,我们争辩说,指纹是对密集弹性登记有意要求的测试,而不仅仅是申请。 首先,山脊图案是准周期性的和当地的自我相似的:滑动一个补丁一个山脊波长产生几乎完美的局部匹配,这在全球是错误的,因此局部匹配面临一个极端的孔径问题,注册网络只能通过整合远程空间环境才能成功. 第二,变形物是真实和自由的:对刚性传感器的弹性皮肤按压和扭曲,在每次获取[12、13、14]时会产生真正的大迁移、非线性曲面,在这种曲面上,刚性模型和类似模型明显失败。 第三,域提供独立的核查甲骨文。 注册评价通常是循环的,因为对齐质量的衡量与被优化的相同类相似功能. 相比之下,指纹minutiae是外部匹配算法所消耗的精确点标:一个恢复真实结构的字段会提高真实匹配的分数,同时让冒牌货的分数保持不变,而一个产生幻觉或折叠结构的字段会立即受到处罚. 第四,函授信号集中在狭义的细带(山脊频率)中,因此指纹隔离了信息保存下采样的因果:破坏山脊带的集合会破坏注册. 最后,程序合成发电机提供了无限的模板-印象训练配对,使得实际基准没有受到零镜头转移评价的影响。

blocks.en: In summary, the primary contributions of this work are as follows: • Cross-domain transfer of unsupervised registration: We transfer the Gum-Net paradigm from volumetric cryo-ET alignment to 2D elastic registration, redesigning all three modules and replacing rigid regression with a Dense Spatial Transformer that predicts a control-point-parameterized dense field 𝚽 \mathbf{\Phi} , trained fully unsupervised, circumventing the deformation ground-truth bottleneck. • Information-preserving spectral downsampling: We implement DCT spectral pooling as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ( ≈ 10 × {\approx}10\times GPU speedup over FFT-based extraction) and ablate it against max and average pooling to isolate its causal effect on registration quality. • Externally validated evaluation: We evaluate predicted fields with structural correlation and through an independent minutiae matcher acting as a topological-correctness oracle, showing that alignment raises genuine similarity while leaving imposter similarity unchanged. We deliberately evaluate depth-first on a single demanding domain; downstream minutiae-matching results serve as a probe of topological correctness and genuine-score separability, not as a benchmark of a complete recognition system.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Dense non-rigid registration and geometric matching
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 非硬度登记和几何匹配

blocks.en: Learned dense correspondence is commonly built on feature correlation and cost-volume constructions that score every spatial location of one feature map against every location of the other, from which displacement fields are regressed [ 2 , 3 ] . Spatial Transformer Networks [ 15 ] established the differentiable-resampling machinery for training end-to-end through a predicted warp; our Dense Spatial Transformer extends this from parametric transformations to a control-point-parameterized dense field. In medical imaging, VoxelMorph [ 1 ] showed dense registration networks can be trained unsupervised , with an image-similarity loss plus smoothness penalty replacing deformation ground truth; in effect, classical intensity-based registration amortized into a feed-forward predictor. In the fingerprint domain, dense registration and displacement-field regression have been studied classically and with deep networks [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 16 ] , but predominantly supervised, trained on simulated or annotated distortion fields. Fully unsupervised estimation of dense non-linear deformation fields remains comparatively unexplored outside the medical domain, and is the setting this work addresses.
blocks.zh: 所学得的密集函证通常基于特征相关性和成本-量的构造,在一个特征图的每个空间位置和另一个位置的每个空间位置之间得分,从这些位置返回[2,3]。 空间变换器网络[15]建立了通过预测曲速对端进行训练的可分辨-对端抽样机械;我们的Dense空间变换器将这种变换从参数化变换扩展到控制点参数化的密集场. 在医学成像中,VoxelMorph [1] 显示密集的注册网络可以训练无监督,有图像-相似性损失加光滑性惩罚取代变形地面真理;实际上,古典强度的注册分期摊销为向导预测器. 在指纹领域,对密集的登记和异地回归进行了经典研究,并建立了深层网络[5、6、7、16],但主要是监督,接受模拟或附加说明的扭曲领域培训。 对密集的非线性变形场的完全无监督估计,在医学领域之外仍然相对没有进行探索,是这项工作地址的设定.

blocks.en: 2.2 Elastic registration in fingerprint biometrics
blocks.zh: 2.2 指纹生物鉴别的弹性登记

blocks.en: Our testbed has its own registration literature. Traditional fingerprint systems are minutiae-based: ridge endings and bifurcations are matched after estimating a geometric transformation between point sets [ 13 ] , typically rigid or locally affine, via Hough-style voting [ 17 ] and RANSAC refinement with local structural descriptors [ 18 , 19 ] . These approaches assume near-rigid geometry and depend on reliable minutiae extraction, which degrades under distortion; since real impressions exhibit non-linear stretching and torque, elastic deformation remains a primary source of false rejections [ 12 ] . Classical elastic registration addressed this directly: Bazen and Gerez fit thin-plate splines to minutiae correspondences [ 12 ] , while Ross, Dass, and Jain estimate average deformation models [ 20 ] and non-linear warps from ridge curve correspondences [ 21 ] . Modern learned pipelines such as C2CL [ 8 ] and contrastive cross-domain approaches [ 22 ] retain explicit alignment modules (e.g., TPS-based rectification), but optimize them through pretrained identity networks or supervised metric learning.
blocks.zh: 我们的测试台有自己的注册文献。 传统的指纹系统基于minutiae:通过Hough式的投票[17]和RANSAC用当地结构描述符进行精细化[18,19],在估计各点集[13]之间的几何转换(典型的刚性或局部外缘)之后,对山脊末端和两侧进行匹配. 这些方法假设近刚性几何,并依赖于可靠的微米提炼,这种提炼在扭曲下降解;由于真实的印象表现出非线性拉伸和扭矩,弹性变形仍然是虚假拒绝的主要来源[12]. 古典弹性注册直接解决了这个问题:巴岑和热雷斯将薄板的样板配合到minutiae函证[12],而罗斯,达斯和贾因则估计平均变形模型[20]和来自脊曲线函证的非线性曲面曲面曲纹[21]. C2CL[8]和对比性跨域方法[22]等现代学习的管道保留了明确的对齐模块(例如基于TPS的校正),但通过预先训练的身份网络或监督的计量学习来优化它们.

blocks.en: Our method is best understood as the learned, amortized analogue of this classical elastic lineage: a control-point grid lifted by smooth interpolation is structurally a free-form deformation model, a close cousin of TPS. But where classical methods solve a per-pair optimization from explicitly extracted correspondences, inheriting the fragility of the extraction step, our network amortizes the inference into a single forward pass from raw pixels, learning the correspondence function itself without supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法最好被理解为这种古典弹性线条的学习,分期模拟:通过平滑插值解除的控制点网格在结构上是一种自由形式变形模型,是TPS的近亲. 但是,当古典的方法从明确提取的函证中解决了每页优化,继承了提取步骤的脆弱性时,我们的网络将推论分期分解成一个来自原始像素的单个前传,在没有监督的情况下学习函证本身的功能.

blocks.en: 2.3 Spectral representations and pooling
blocks.zh: 2.3 光谱表达和集合

blocks.en: Frequency-domain techniques have long served the testbed domain for enhancement, translation-invariant matching, and compact descriptors [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] , but for representation or rigid alignment rather than for learning non-rigid correspondence. Separately, spectral pooling (subsampling by truncating high-frequency transform coefficients) preserves substantially more spatial information per parameter than max or average pooling, with DFT [ 9 ] , DCT [ 11 ] , and Hartley [ 10 ] variants. This property is not domain-specific: it is a principled alternative to spatial subsampling whenever deformation must be estimated from fine structure, which is exactly the regime our testbed maximizes.
blocks.zh: 频率域技术长期服务于测试台域,用于增强,翻译-变量匹配,以及紧凑的描述符[23,24,25,26,27],但用于表示或刚性对齐,而不是用于学习非刚性通信. 另外,光谱集合(通过切换高频变换系数进行子样本)保存的每个参数的空间信息大大多于最大或平均集合,DFT[9],DCT[11],以及哈特利[10]变体. 这种财产并非特定领域:每当变形必须从精细结构中估算时,它就是一种有原则的替代空间分样法,而精细结构正是我们试验床最优化的制度。

blocks.en: 2.4 Unsupervised learning in the testbed domain
blocks.zh: 2.4 试验区内的无监督学习

blocks.en: Unsupervised learning has been explored for fingerprints through RBMs, autoencoders, and GAN-based enhancement [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] , showing that structural priors can be learned without annotation, while deep matchers, whether CNN-based [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] or transformer-based [ 35 , 36 ] , learn identity-discriminative features without explicitly modeling elastic deformation, which remains a major cause of matching errors. In contrast, we learn the deformation field itself, densely and without labels.
blocks.zh: 已经通过RMBS,自动编码器,以及基于GAN的增强[28,29,30],探索了无监督的学习指纹,显示结构前科可以不作注释而学习,而深度匹配器,无论是基于CNN的[31,32,33,34]还是基于变压器的[35,36],学习身份区别特征而没有明确建模弹性变形,这仍然是匹配错误的一个主要原因. 相比之下,我们学习变形场本身,密集且没有标签.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our model is shown in Figure 1 . It takes two grayscale images: the reference (fixed) image S a S_{a} and the moving image S b S_{b} to be registered onto it. In our evaluation domain these are a fingerprint master template and an impression of the same finger, pairs that synthetic generators produce natively ( Section 4 ). Weight-shared feature extractors produce feature maps v a v_{a} and v b v_{b} , which a Siamese matching module converts into two correlation maps: at spatial coordinate ( i , j ) (i,j) , c a ​ b c_{ab} holds the similarity between v a v_{a} at ( i , j ) (i,j) and all features of v b v_{b} , with c b ​ a c_{ba} defined symmetrically. Both maps are processed by identical network branches, flattened, and concatenated to estimate the transformation parameters. The spatial transformation is realized by a dense deformation field 𝚽 ∈ ℝ H × W × 2 \mathbf{\Phi}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 2} ; however, to ensure smoothness and reduce complexity, we do not regress this field directly. blocks.en: Popular feature-extraction backbones such as DenseNet [ 38 ] , InceptionNet [ 39 ] , and ResNet [ 40 ] rely on max or average pooling, whereas spectral subsampling preserves considerably more spatial information per parameter while allowing flexible output dimensionality [ 9 ] . Two-dimensional spectral pooling can be based on the DFT [ 9 ] , DCT [ 11 ] , or Hartley transform [ 10 ] ; among these, the DCT has recurred in fingerprint pipelines [ 23 , 24 ] and, relying only on real-valued cosine functions rather than complex exponentials, produces output in the real domain ℝ \mathbb{R} .
blocks.zh: DenseNet[38]、InceptionNet[39]和ResNet[40]等流行的地物采集主干网依赖于最大或平均集合,而光谱子样本则保留了相当多的每个参数的空间信息,同时允许灵活的输出维度[ 9] (中文(简体) ). 二维光谱集合可以基于DFT[9],DCT[11],或哈特利变换[10];其中DCT在指纹管道中重现[23,24],并且仅依靠真实值的余弦函数而不是复杂的指数,在真实域R\mathbb{R}中产生输出.

blocks.en: We implement our own 2D spectral pooling layer based on the 2D Type-II DCT. Our implementation achieves a significant computational speed-up by decomposing the 2D transform into sequential 1D transforms and pre-computing the spectral transformation bases via an identity-matrix mapping. This reframes the transform as a pure General Matrix Multiply (GEMM) operation, achieving a 50 × 50\times speedup on CUDA devices (details in Appendix C ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Siamese matching module
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 暹罗匹配模块

blocks.en: While matching is often treated as an independent post-processing step [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 , 3 ] , the 2D correlation layer of [ 2 ] integrates matching information directly: acting as a normalized cross-correlation G : ℝ C × H × W × ℝ C × H × W → ℝ ( H ​ W ) × H × W G:\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W}\times\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{(HW)\times H\times W} , it flattens one feature map to ℝ C × N \mathbb{R}^{C\times N} ( N = H ​ W N=HW ) and computes, for each spatial feature of the other map, a dot product against all N N flattened features. While effective, this breaks all spatial axes of one input while preserving the other. For precise alignment of fine, repeating structure, preserving the spatial hierarchy of both images is critical, since the reference and moving images differ fundamentally in their photometric properties. Inspired by the 3D matching approach in Gum-Net [ 4 ] , we therefore propose a symmetric 2D Siamese correlation layer that computes two maps, C a ​ b C_{ab} and C b ​ a C_{ba} , processed in parallel.

blocks.en: 3.3 Unsupervised non-linear alignment module
blocks.zh: 3.3 无监督的非线性对齐模块

blocks.en: Unlike the original Gum-Net [ 4 ] , which regresses a rigid 3D transformation suitable for macromolecular structures, our architecture predicts a dense deformation field 𝚽 \mathbf{\Phi} . The non-linear alignment module translates the correlation representations from Section 3.2 into a pixel-wise displacement field in two stages: control-point regression and dense flow-field generation. Control point regression: Each correlation branch is reduced by six successive 1024 1024 -channel valid convolutions to spatial size 2 × 2 2\times 2 and flattened to ℝ 4096 \mathbb{R}^{4096} ; the two branches are concatenated into a joint representation v c ​ o ​ r ​ r ∈ ℝ 8192 v_{corr}\in\mathbb{R}^{8192} that captures the geometric consensus (full architecture in Appendix A ). v c ​ o ​ r ​ r v_{corr} is fed into a multi-layer perceptron with two hidden layers of 2000 ReLU units. The final regressor head projects an output vector d ∈ ℝ 2 ​ G 2 d\in\mathbb{R}^{2G^{2}} , where G G is the resolution of the sparse control-point grid. We reshape d d with the operator ℛ : ℝ 2 ​ G 2 → ℝ 2 × G × G \mathcal{R}:\mathbb{R}^{2G^{2}}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{2\times G\times G} , mapping the linear activations onto their spatial coordinates on the control-point grid to obtain Δ ​ 𝐏 = ( Δ ​ x , Δ ​ y ) \Delta{\mathbf{P}}=(\Delta{x},\Delta{y}) . Dense flow field generation: To generate a smooth, topology-preserving dense deformation field, we upsample the coarse control points to the input resolution ( H , W ) (H,W) using bicubic interpolation: 𝚽 = Upsample b ​ i ​ c ​ u ​ b ​ i ​ c ​ ( Δ ​ 𝐏 ) \mathbf{\Phi}=\text{Upsample}_{bicubic}(\Delta\mathbf{P}) (4) where 𝚽 ∈ ℝ H × W × 2 \mathbf{\Phi}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 2} . The final aligned image S b ^ S_{\hat{b}} is generated by spatially resampling the moving image S b S_{b} according to 𝚽 \mathbf{\Phi} : S b ^ = S b ∘ 𝚽 S_{\hat{b}}=S_{b}\circ\mathbf{\Phi} (5) This parameterization is, structurally, a free-form deformation model: any field in the network’s range is a bicubic lift of a coarse lattice, so smoothness is enforced architecturally , as high-frequency or folding fields are inexpressible, and is only refined, not created, by the regularizer below. It is the learned analogue of classical spline-based elastic registration [ 12 , 21 ] , with correspondence extraction and per-pair optimization amortized into one forward pass.

4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We train Gum-Net entirely on synthetic data and evaluate on synthetic as well as real-world data. Unlike [ 4 ] , we perform no fine-tuning or adaptation on real-world datasets: the model is evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, so all real-data results directly measure synthetic-to-real transfer of the learned registration function.
blocks.zh: 我们完全依靠合成数据来训练Gum-Net,并评价合成数据以及现实世界数据。 与[4]不同,我们没有在现实世界数据集上进行微调或调整:模型在真实基准上被评价为零拍,因此所有真实数据结果都直接测量了所学注册功能的合成-实际转移.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: As real-world benchmarks providing organically generated elastic deformation, we evaluate on the FVC2004 benchmark [ 46 ] (110 fingers, 8 impressions each across 4 databases) and the Tsinghua Distorted Fingerprint Dataset (320 pairs of undistorted and distorted impressions) [ 47 ] . We use FVC2004 to quantify pre-matching structural alignment improvements via the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC). Conversely, the Tsinghua dataset features severe real-world torque and complex skin distortion, and we use it exclusively to stress-test downstream minutiae matching behavior.
blocks.zh: 作为提供有机生成弹性变形的现实世界基准,我们评价FVC2004基准[46](110指,4个数据库各有8个印象)和清华扭曲指纹数据集(320对未分解和扭曲的印象)[47]. 我们利用FVC2004通过皮尔逊关联系数(PCC)量化预匹配结构对齐改进. 反之,清华数据集则具有严重真实世界的扭矩和复杂的皮肤扭曲特征,我们只用它来测试下游的敏捷匹配行为.

blocks.en: We use Anguli [ 48 ] , a free and open-source synthetic fingerprint generator developed at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, to generate 73,500 fingerprints: 2,100 distinct impressions per noise level per class, across five signal-to-noise ratios and all fingerprint classes of the Henry classification [ 49 ] . The generator first produces a master template image, then casts impressions from that template ( Figures 7 and 8 in the appendix show the templates and corpus diversity). Anguli is a procedural generator: it synthesizes orientation fields from mathematical models of singular points and grows ridge patterns by iterative filtering [ 48 , 50 ] . It is not a learned generative model fitted to real fingerprints, so synthetic training involves no real biometric data at any stage; real datasets are used strictly for evaluation. Beyond scale, this yields unlimited reference–moving training pairs with correspondence guaranteed by construction.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Anguli[48],这是印度科学研究所孟加拉鲁开发的免费和开源的合成指纹生成器,生成73,500个指纹:每个等级的噪声水平有2,100个明显的印象,跨越五个信号对噪声比和亨利分类的所有指纹类别[49]. 生成器首先生成主模板图像,然后从该模板中产生印象(附录中图7和图8显示了模板和实体的多样性)。 Anguli是一个程序生成器:它从单数点的数学模型中合成方向字段,并通过迭代过滤[48,50]来生长脊线图案. 它不是一个符合真实指纹的有学问的基因模型,所以合成培训在任何阶段都不涉及真正的生物鉴别数据;真正的数据集严格用于评价. 除了规模以外,这还会产生无限的参考-移动培训配对与建筑保证的通信。

blocks.en: Two observations deserve comment. First, on synthetic data the max- and average-pooling variants do not merely underperform; they reduce decidability relative to no alignment at all: alignment quality, not alignment presence, drives the downstream benefit, and a poorly estimated warp is worse than none. Second, on Tsinghua the average-pooling variant attains a marginally higher genuine mean than DCT (44.03 vs. 43.97), while DCT retains the best decidability. We hypothesize that Tsinghua’s enhanced, binarized impressions reduce the fine-detail advantage spectral pooling provides on raw ridge imagery; the unambiguous synthetic ordering isolates the effect on unprocessed structure. Characterizing this preprocessing–pooling interaction remains open.
blocks.zh: 有两点值得评论。 首先,在合成数据方面,最大和平均集合的变体不仅表现不佳;它们比完全不对齐降低了可解性:对齐的质量,而不是对齐的存在,驱动下游的好处,估计差的曲面比零差。 第二,在清华,平均集合变体的真值略高于DCT(44.03对43.97),而DCT保留了最好的可解性。 我们假设清华强化的二进制印象会减少原始山脊图象的细微细节优势; 毫不含糊的合成命令会隔离对未加工结构的影响。 描述此预处理- 集合交互仍然开放 。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end unsupervised framework for dense non-rigid 2D image registration, obtained by transferring the original 3D Gum-Net [ 4 ] from volumetric cryo-ET alignment to two dimensions and replacing its rigid transformation module with a Dense Spatial Transformer, so that a smooth dense deformation field is predicted without ground-truth displacement annotations while DCT spectral pooling and control-point parameterization preserve the fine structure on which correspondence depends. Trained purely on synthetic fingerprint data and evaluated zero-shot, the method improves structural correlation by 10.5% (synthetic) and up to 15.7% (FVC2004), and on Tsinghua raises genuine match scores while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged, confirming deformation quality through an external matcher rather than the training objective alone. Evaluation is restricted to a single domain by design and reports distribution-level summaries rather than operating characteristics; future work includes extending to other imagery where fine quasi-periodic structure meets elastic deformation, operational metrics on larger datasets, and coupling with fixed-length embeddings [ 33 ] for retrieval at scale.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了2D Gum-Net,这是密集非刚性2D图像注册的端到端的无监督框架,通过将原来的3D Gum-Net[4]从体积低温-ET对齐转移到两个维度,并用Dense空间变形器取代其刚性变形模块,从而在没有地面真知灼见说明的情况下预测一个平滑的密集变形场,而DCT光谱集合和控制点参数化则保留了通信所依赖的精细结构. 完全通过合成指纹数据培训并评价零射线,该方法提高了10.5%(合成)和高达15.7%(FVC2004)的结构关联性,在清华提高真对分,同时让冒牌手的分数基本保持不变,通过外部匹配者,而不是仅通过培训目标来确认变形质量. 通过设计和报告分布级摘要,而不是操作特征,评价仅限于一个单一领域;今后的工作包括扩展到其他图像,其中精细的准周期结构满足弹性变形,大型数据集上的操作度量衡,并与固定长嵌入[33]配合进行大规模检索。
